tests.name: 4909真实2096回合开始双防各一，明确零目标等级转化消耗原单位，组数取正双攻较小值并回复17%
tests.assertion: test('4909真实2096回合开始双防各一，明确零目标等级转化消耗原单位，组数取正双攻较小值并回复17%',()=>{for(const[def,spd,groups]of[[0,0,1],[1,2,2],[2,0,1],[-1,-1,0]]){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000});s.fighters[0].stages.def=def;s.fighters[0].stages.spd=spd;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.def,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spd,0);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,def+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spa,spd+1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.puppet4909.groups,groups);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,1000+1530*groups);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['钢傀双攻组红伤增幅']?.fraction??0,.17*groups);if(groups===0)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects['钢傀双攻组红伤增幅'],undefined);}});

tests.name: 4909真实2096按当前最大HP回复、技能禁疗不封锁魂印，普通回复削减及满体上限照常
tests.assertion: test('4909真实2096按当前最大HP回复、技能禁疗不封锁魂印，普通回复削减及满体上限照常',()=>{for(const mode of['normal','ban','cut','full']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:mode==='full'?9000:1000});if(mode==='ban')timer(s,0,'技能禁疗');if(mode==='cut')timer(s,0,'回复效果削减',{fraction:.5});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,mode==='full'?9000:mode==='cut'?1765:2530);}const changed=make({move:10086,soul:true,hp:1000});changed.fighters[0].stats.maxHp=10000;turn(changed,10086,20309);assert.equal(changed.fighters[0].hp,2700);});

tests.name: 4909真实2096受到正数完整技能红伤才敌当前起3回免攻失效，次数不消费、到期恢复且固定/零红不触发
tests.assertion: test('4909真实2096受到正数完整技能红伤才敌当前起3回免攻失效，次数不消费、到期恢复且固定/零红不触发',()=>{for(const type of['timed','count']){const s=make({move:10086,soul:true,aStats:{spe:50},hp:1000});if(type==='timed')timer(s,1,'攻击伤害免疫');else s.fighters[1].counts.attackNullify=2;turn(s,10086,10127);assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['钢傀攻击免疫失效'].start,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['钢傀攻击免疫失效'].end,3);if(type==='count')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.attackNullify,2);observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='afterUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.clearBoost(c.a);},()=>{for(let r=2;r<=4;r++){turn(s,10086,20309);assert.equal(sum(s)>0,r<=3);}});if(type==='count')assert.equal(s.fighters[1].counts.attackNullify,1);}const zero=make({move:10086,soul:true});timer(zero,0,'攻击伤害免疫');turn(zero,10086,10127);assert.equal(zero.fighters[1].effects['钢傀攻击免疫失效'],undefined);const fixed=make({move:10086,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.hurt(c.t,100,'隔离已知固定伤害','fixed');},()=>turn(fixed,10086,20309));assert.equal(fixed.fighters[1].effects['钢傀攻击免疫失效'],undefined);});

tests.name: 4909真实2096下一回红伤提升17%不是固定真伤增幅，先消除自身强化可独立验证到期且不猜非零目标转化
tests.assertion: test('4909真实2096下一回红伤提升17%不是固定真伤增幅，先消除自身强化可独立验证到期且不猜非零目标转化',()=>{const a=make({move:10086,soul:true}),b=make({move:10086,soul:true});turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);delete b.fighters[0].effects['钢傀双攻组红伤增幅'];const clear=(e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.clearBoost(c.t);};observe(clear,()=>{turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);});assert.ok(sum(a)>=Math.floor(sum(b)*1.17));assert.ok(sum(a)<=Math.ceil(sum(b)*1.17));observe(clear,()=>{turn(a,10086,20309);turn(b,10086,20309);});assert.equal(sum(a),sum(b));});

tests.assertion: test('4909全部17招各64种子真实基础HP/PP，真实2096首次17招已知14招执行另3招非零目标转化明确待答',()=>{for(const m of source.moves)for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({move:m.id,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0}),before=s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)];turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],before-1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)&&f.hp>=0&&f.hp<=f.stats.maxHp));}for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,soul:true});if([27321,29366,27323].includes(m.id)){const before=structuredClone(s);assert.throws(()=>turn(s,m.id,20309),/Q-4909-001/);assert.deepEqual(s,before);}else{turn(s,m.id,20309);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.puppet4909.events.length,1);assert.ok(s.fighters.every(f=>Number.isFinite(f.hp)));}}});
